verdict.rationale: CDP documents payout/disbursement capability (fiat or crypto to onchain addresses, email, or bank accounts) from a custodial account, implying ops teams could programmatically send many payouts via repeated API calls, but there is no documented dedicated batch/bulk payout endpoint or per-item status reporting for a single 'mass disbursement' operation. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk payout API documentation, per-item status tracking/response schema, and any evidence of throughput/rate guarantees for mass disbursement use cases.
